def find_ski_path(n, types, ski_tracks):
    # Find the index of the hotel
    hotel_index = types.index(1)
    
    # Initialize the path with the hotel
    path = [hotel_index + 1]
    
    # Follow the ski tracks to build the path
    current_index = hotel_index
    while ski_tracks[current_index] != 0:
        next_index = ski_tracks[current_index] - 1
        path.append(next_index + 1)
        current_index = next_index
    
    # Return the path length and the path itself
    return len(path), path
